# Foozhan Ataiefard

Pronouns: he/him.

Foozhan Ataiefard is a senior AI researcher working on VLM, GenAI, image and video generation, model optimization, foundation models, post-training, long-context modeling, VLM and LLM efficiency, diffusion-based rendering, model architecture design, and reinforcement learning.

He currently works at NVIDIA as a DevTech Engineer.
